label: Interpretive: in the tertia via, 'aliquando nihil fuit' is inferred from 'quod possibile est non…
paraphrase: Interpretive: in the tertia via, 'aliquando nihil fuit' is inferred from 'quod possibile est non esse, quandoque non est' applied to each thing, i.e. by shifting 'each thing at some time is not' to 'at some time nothing is'.
